transcript: my product arrived damaged what should i do now
response:
Hello! I am ZentroMart's AI customer support assistant. 

If your product arrived damaged, please follow these steps:

1. **Safety Check:** If the product shows any safety risks (such as a swelling battery, burning smell, sparks, or heat), stop using it immediately. *(Note: If this applies, I will immediately connect you with a human agent).*
2. **Deadline:** Report the damage within **48 hours of delivery**.
3. **Required Evidence:** Provide photos of both the damaged item and its packaging.

**Available Resolutions:**
Once verified, you will receive a free replacement or a full refund (including delivery fees), with no reverse pickup fee. 

*(Please note: If the damaged item is worth more than ₹10,000, I will need to create a ticket and hand your case over to our Priority Resolution team.)*

document_evidence.title: Damaged, wrong or missing items policy
document_evidence.text: Report a damaged, defective, expired, wrong or missing item within **48 hours of delivery**, with photos of the item and the packaging. This applies to every category, including grocery and other non-returnable items.

document_evidence.title: Damaged, wrong or missing items policy
document_evidence.text: Claims for items worth more than ₹10,000 are handled by the Priority Resolution team. The support agent must create a ticket and hand over; the agent cannot approve these claims.

document_evidence.title: Damaged, wrong or missing items policy
document_evidence.text: Reports after 48 hours are handled as a normal return if the item is still within its return window. Otherwise the customer can use the brand or ZentroMart Assured warranty, if any.

document_evidence.title: Escalation and human handover
document_evidence.section: [ESC-1] When to hand over to a human
document_evidence.text:
Hand over at once when any of these is true:

1. **Damaged, defective or wrong item worth more than ₹10,000.**
2. **Customer reports an order, payment or account activity they did not make.**
3. **Customer mentions legal action, a consumer court or a police complaint.**
4. **Third or later contact about the same issue within 7 days.**
5. **Refund more than 3 business days past its maximum timeline.**
6. **Customer asks for a human agent.**
7. **Product safety risk such as a swelling battery, burning smell, sparks or injury.**

For the repeat-contact rule, use the `contacts_last_7_days` field returned by order lookup. It counts earlier contacts only, not the current one. Escalate when it is 2 or more.
